note: Uses the 128k-source 50 kHz analytical ultrasound SLQ run with T_skull=0.5 inside a 15 deg +x cone and T_skull=0.1 elsewhere. The per-source variance is scaled by the 2 MHz 2-cycle axial slice fraction 0.00513333 and the 0.01 voxel-to-sensor CBV-variability amplitude factor squared; the SLQ run used input_power_per_source=5.13333e-07. Full-volume unit-variance bitrate was 769052 bit/s from results/variants/us_free_field_analytical_50khz_128k_rbc_cone_20260602/json/001_50khz_128000src_6000sensors.json; the unscaled one-slice bitrate was 278774 bit/s from results/variants/us_free_field_analytical_50khz_128k_rbc_cone_slice_20260602/json/001_50khz_128000src_6000sensors.json; the 1% CBV one-slice 50 kHz bitrate was 1106.72 bit/s from results/variants/us_free_field_analytical_50khz_128k_rbc_cone_slice_cbv1pct_20260602/json/001_50khz_128000src_6000sensors.json. The final table rate multiplies that 50 kHz SLQ estimate by lambda^3 = (2e+06/50000)^3 = 64000, giving 7.08298e+07 bit/s. The displayed output amplitude is sqrt(Frobenius/n_outputs) times sqrt(slice fraction) times the CBV variability amplitude factor, giving 0.00072268 Pa RMS against 0.005 Pa noise. Baseline 10 cm pair pressures before the 0.01 CBV-variability factor are outside/outside=0.00587878 Pa, inside/outside=0.0293939 Pa, and inside/inside=0.146969 Pa; the variable component is 0.01 times these pressures. Water-filled capacity was not recomputed from a full spectrum for this SLQ-only run; the capacity column repeats the lambda^3-scaled equal-power SLQ bitrate as a lower-bound proxy.
